name: Sri Lotus Developers & Realty Ltd
business_description: Sri Lotus Developers & Realty Ltd develops and sells residential and commercial real estate properties, primarily through redevelopment projects in Mumbai's western suburbs. The company generates revenue by constructing ultra-luxury and luxury properties and selling them to end-users or investors.
input_sensitivity: (1) Cost risks: Highly sensitive to land acquisition costs, construction materials (cement, steel), labor expenses, and interest rates, all of which directly impact project margins. (2) Revenue/demand risks: Demand is driven by the health of the Mumbai luxury real estate market, interest rates, and overall economic sentiment among high-net-worth individuals and businesses seeking premium properties.
output_note: End-users (individuals and businesses) directly pay the company for completed ultra-luxury and luxury residential or commercial real estate units.
